comparison_purpose: Preregistered common IEM METAR source and TAF prevailing availability subset; no refitting
difference_definition: candidate minus reference; positive is worse

bootstrap.method: paired non-circular moving UTC date blocks
bootstrap.pooled_interval: resample the full validation calendar; blocks never cross date gaps
bootstrap.empty_resamples: Exclude only bootstrap replicates with sampled n=0; valid replicate counts are reported; no prediction rows are dropped
bootstrap.weighting: sum AE / sum n; sqrt(sum SE / sum n); same sampled dates for both models

interpretation: Paired sampling uncertainty, not causal evidence; explicit subsets are supplementary comparisons
